name: Empower Gwinnett Government Internship Program
what_you_do: Two Saturday workshops in May, then a four-week paid internship in a county department. The page says interns develop leadership skills through workshops and on-the-job training.
who_can_apply: Gwinnett County residents or students who go to school in Gwinnett County, ages 15 to 21. You must be 15 by the first workshop. You must be free for the whole paid internship program. You need a reliable ride. You cannot be a past Empower Gwinnett County Government intern. No grades or work experience are required.
pay_detail: $15 per hour for the two workshops and the four-week internship
deadline_text: Last cycle (2026 page): apply Feb 9 to Mar 16, workshops May 9 and May 16, internship June 1 to June 26. The 2027 dates are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application during the posted window. A form link is on the program page. Human Resources picks applicants based on interests, career goals and department needs. No interview is required. Selected applicants get a conditional job offer. Some jobs may need a background check.
notes: A work permit is required if you are 15. The main page says the 2026 application is closed. It says the 2027 application period will be posted there. Questions: HREmployeeEngagement@GwinnettCounty.com.
